Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal

Class TerminalDef

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal.TerminalDef
public class TerminalDef extends Object
The options of a terminal card: where its bytes and (optionally) its step events come from.
Example:

TerminalDef def = TerminalDef.forMixin("build", "/runs", "r42") .eventsUrl("/runs/juneau-run-view/r42/events") .title("Build") .validate();

Since:
10.0.0
